row.sourceMeaning: A source-only base for the original all-order moving matrix/physical jet ledger; no matrix or Gaussian source binding is asserted here.

domain.referenceChart: The original (R,Z,T), with T>=0, q=Q_ref*s>0 and 1/2<=s<=2.
domain.exactPrefixProof: The actual common b_n is monotone. For n>=N+1, b_n*q>=1; the original time cutoff and all its derivatives are exactly zero, including at the flat endpoint.
domain.bandFloorProof: q<2^(-(ell0+4)) implies -log2(q)>ell0+4. Every active |ell+log2(q)|<3/4 therefore has ell>=ell0.
domain.compatibleAtlas: For any two prefix orders valid at this same q, every extra coefficient is exactly zero together with all derivatives. The backgrounds, phases, original matrices, Volterra solutions, H and fixed positive a coincide by ODE uniqueness. The actual monotone b_n>=2^n makes these prefix domains cover every q>0.

exactTail.proof: ell<=floor(log2(b_(N+1)))-1 implies b_(N+1)*2^(-ell-1)>=1. For q>=2^(-ell-1), every n>=N+1 has b_n*q>=1 and all original cutoff derivatives vanish.

coverage.proof: The next lower endpoint is floor(log2(b_(N+1))), exactly one more than this upper endpoint, apart from the common ell0 maximum. Since b_n>=2^n, the upper endpoints tend to infinity.

domain.sourceWindow: The concrete band includes every active coefficient through its certified cutoff window. Its first omitted term and every derivative vanish by the original selector; this one window is not claimed to cover every q.
domain.allBandRecipe: For each other valid prefix window run the same original selector, field, carrier, frame, exact Volterra and H construction. All norm constants here come from the same common family and are independent of the chosen window and discrete labels.
domain.classCoordinates: Fixed-label (R,Z,T,xi,v); representative, ell, mesh labels and rounded carriers are frozen before differentiation.
domain.wholeAnnulus: Xa<X<Xb, s in[1/2,2], eta in[-1,1] on the same original box. The actual positive weights extend smoothly by zero at both original flat edges.
domain.derivativeExecution: Every requested norm leaf is constructed. The private current has a separate finite slow-jet execution budget; the class proof does not assert that every high-order current derivative graph was materialized.
